# Parse old_songs.txt content to extract song titles and artists
import re

content = old_songs['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line "# Archived Songs"
song_entries = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    # Remove leading "- "
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " (last occurrence? but there might be " by " in title? assume first)
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.rsplit(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        song_entries.append((title, artists))
    else:
        # No artist info, just title
        song_entries.append((line.strip(), []))

print(song_entries)
